verdict.rationale: The docs clearly show in-person payments on compatible readers and contactless acceptance through Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android devices, which covers the contactless part of the story. The pack never explicitly mentions chip (EMV) insertion or Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance, so those parts are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV card acceptance evidence, explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay mobile-wallet support, independent hands-on corroboration.
